Video Intercom Door Locks

Models with a doorbell and indoor screen start at RM1,730 including installation. Visitors can be seen on the indoor display, and some models add remote talk and remote unlock over stable Wi-Fi.

Models in this category

Decide where you need to answer the door

Compare the indoor screen position and size for viewing from home. If you also need to answer while away, check remote talk and remote unlock on the individual model.

Test Wi-Fi with the doors shut

Check your home Wi-Fi on a phone beside the lock position. Repeat with the door and any outer grille shut to see how the connection behaves during normal use.

Check the camera view at the usual standing point

Take a photo from where a visitor presses the bell. Ask the installer whether grille bars, the frame or a narrow corridor will block the view.

Frequently asked questions

How much do these locks cost including installation?

The 6 models cost from RM1,730 to RM2,960 including installation.

What should I check before installation?

Compare the indoor screen position and size for viewing from home. If you also need to answer while away, check remote talk and remote unlock on the individual model.

What does the price include?

Installation is included with every smart lock at no extra charge. If your door needs drilling or alterations, we’ll discuss the work with you first.
